Finally figured out how to send a photo on this new phone 📱. Took me half an hour but I did it. Made stew for the whole family and they ate everything. Then I sat with my knitting and finished the blue scarf. I still reach for your chair in the evenings, Papa. Three years now and I still talk to you when the house is quiet, and some days the quiet is TOO loud.

After class I met Ama outside the library. We went to the student fellowship at the church hall and sang two hymns. Then we walked to the station and split a plate of jollof from the stall. She paid me back right away, which was a relief. I checked my banking app on the bus: dorm fee due Friday, and my card got declined at the bookstore again. So I wrote a tiny budget — transport, data, and one treat for the week. Back in the room I did my laundry and swept the floor before dark. Before bed I filled my water bottle and set my alarm for the morning.
